utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely, it’s still happening Sunday at the community center. Thanks for keeping everyone posted, Rosa.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Tess — I appreciate that. Let’s keep reminding folks and make sure everything’s set for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Will do — I’ll keep spreading the word and check if anyone still needs help for Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Quinn. Please put me down for a clear job at the front porch on Saturday, and let me know the exact time.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll put you down for the front porch on Saturday and send the exact time as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Quinn. Please keep me posted, and I’ll be there at the front porch on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still catching up on everything—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late—what still needs doing for the repair drive? I can help sort and load if you still need an extra hand.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Dane — I heard it’s this Saturday at the front porch, and we still need helpers. Sorting and loading would be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, it sounds like it’s going well. I can swing by later and check if they still need anything.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I’ll compare notes and see what’s still missing. If you spot anything on your check, let me know and I’ll add it to the list.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’ll let you know if I spot anything they still need.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Jules — I’m still sorting the list for Saturday, and any help with setup or spreadin’ the word would be a relief. If you can stop by the front porch, I’ll tell you what’s left.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sure thing — I can stop by the front porch and help with setup or spread the word. Just let me know what’s left, and I’ll jump in.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Jules — that’d help a lot. I’m still needin’ a few hands for setup, signs, and maybe a table or two if you’ve got ’em.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Sam, are we still on for the repair drive this Saturday? Have we settled which repairs we’re covering?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, we’re still on for Saturday at the front porch. I’m happy to help with whatever repairs you’ve lined up—just tell me what needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks—can you help with the easiest items first, like loose hinges and small leaks?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Vik, I’m trying to work around the school pickup schedule for the repair drive—what time were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’m planning to swing by the repair drive and see what they need, and I’ll let you know as soon as I pick a time.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Vik — that helps. Just let me know when you’ve got a time, and I’ll see how it fits the school pickup schedule.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Leo — I’m still checking the list, then I’ll send you the gaps so we can keep the repair drive organized.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — send me the gaps when you have them, and I’ll help fill in what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Will do — I’m sorting it out now and should have the gaps to you soon.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’m still a bit behind—what’s the latest on the repair drive? If you’ve got the updated supply list, I can take a look.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is still on for this afternoon, right?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yes, that’s right—still on for this afternoon. If you want, send me the updated supply list and I’ll take a look.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m starting at the front porch this Saturday, and I could use a few helpers. If you know anyone available, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Opal—I can help, and I’ll ask around for a few more helpers too. Just let me know what time you want us at the front porch this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Mara — let’s meet at 9 a.m. at the front porch this Saturday. I’ll keep a list going, so send anyone you find my way.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus — I could use a hand sorting tools and setting up the porch. If you’re free Saturday, that’d help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely — I can help sort tools and set up the porch on Saturday. I’ll bring a few useful tools by too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus — that would be a big help. If you can, come by a little before we start so we can set everything out together.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Oren — I’ll send the list once I’ve got the gaps sorted, and we can keep the repair drive moving.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good, Bo — just send me the list when it’s ready, and I’ll keep an eye out for the tools at the community center on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, Oren — I’ll do that and let you know if I still need anything for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: It’s this Saturday at the front porch, and I still need a few helpers to set up, greet folks, and sort donations. If you can make it, I’d really appreciate the help.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’m already spreading the word, and I can add your name to the repair drive list too.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Quinn — that would be a big help. If you can, please tell folks I still need a couple more hands for setup, greeting, and sorting donations this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Cleo. I’ll wait for your list and then we can fill in the gaps.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll put together a quick list of what we still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Cleo. Once you’ve got it, send me the list and I’ll help with the missing parts.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help out with the repair drive—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rey — I’m still sorting tools and labels, and I need help keeping track of who’s bringing what. Since it’s now Sunday at the community center, could you help with setup there?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I can help with setup at the community center. I can keep track of who’s bringing what too—just point me to the list.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right — the repair drive got moved to Sunday at the community center, didn’t it? I’m still in; just tell me where to show up and what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yep, Sunday at the community center is right. I’ll swing by later and see what they still need, then I’ll let you know what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good — just let me know, and I’ll be there Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, right — thanks for the update, Rosa. I’ll tell folks it’s Sunday at the community center now.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — I’ll be here if anyone needs a tool or two for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Gus — that’s a big help. I’ll spread the word and send anyone needing tools your way on Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Kira, are we still on for the repair drive this weekend? I’m starting at the front porch Saturday—can you help?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, it’s still on for this afternoon, right?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: It’s for Saturday at the front porch, not this afternoon. Can you still help then?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Hana — I still need a few helpers to sort items and set up the front porch this Saturday. If you can, please put your name on the list.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Eli — I can help sort items and set up the front porch this Saturday. Where should I add my name?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great — you can add your name to the list with Quinn, and I’ll make sure you’re down for sorting items and setup this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes — it’s now on Sunday at the community center. I’m just lining up the first items to check in, and I’m happy to point you where to start.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. Sunday at the community center works — I’ll start with check-in and help where you need me.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful, Uli — could you start by setting up the check-in table near the entrance? Once that’s ready, I’ll send the first items your way.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’m still a bit behind—what’s the latest on the repair drive? If you’ve got an updated supply list, I can take a look.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It’s still on, and they’re mainly collecting donations and tools for the fixes. I’m checking the list now, and if anything’s missing I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — thanks. Send me the updated list when you have it, and I’ll take a look.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still catching up—what’s the latest on what we still need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: We still need a couple more helpers, plus tables and basic tool check-ins for Saturday at the front porch. If you can lend a hand, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it—thanks for the update. I can help out and I’ll check if I can bring a table too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Opal — I’ve got the repair drive this Saturday at the front porch, and I could really use a hand keeping things moving.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great — I’ll keep track of the locations and help keep things moving at the front porch this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, thanks — just keep an eye on the list and flag anything urgent so we can stay organized.
